def transform(grid):
    # Color each 1-valued plus-shaped symbol with the color of the matching
    # plus-shaped exemplar. Other pixels/objects stay unchanged.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Exemplar pluses in this task are 3x3 motifs with center and four arms.
    colors=[]
    for r in range(1,h-1):
      for c in range(1,w-1):
       col=grid[r][c]
       if col and all(grid[y][x]==col for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))):
        colors.append((r,c,col))
    # For each 1 plus, select closest exemplar color of a different color.
    for r in range(1,h-1):
      for c in range(1,w-1):
       if grid[r][c]==1 and all(grid[y][x]==1 for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))):
        candidates=[(abs(y-r)+abs(x-c),col) for y,x,col in colors if col!=1]
        if candidates:
         _,col=min(candidates)
         for y,x in ((r,c),(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)): out[y][x]=col
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Identify same-color 8-connected objects, then recolor each 1-object to the
    # color of an exactly matching exemplar shape (orientation preserved).
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]; seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       color=grid[r][c]
       if color and (r,c) not in seen:
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while stack:
         y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
         for dy in (-1,0,1):
          for dx in (-1,0,1):
           yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
           if (dy or dx) and 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
            seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        norm=frozenset((y-min(a for a,b in cells),x-min(b for a,b in cells)) for y,x in cells)
        comps.append((color,cells,norm))
    refs={}
    for color,cells,norm in comps:
      if color!=1: refs[norm]=color
    for color,cells,norm in comps:
      if color==1 and norm in refs:
       for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=refs[norm]
    return out
